review.dimensions: These standards apply to Sub-District A, the senior living site. Sub-District B has its own minimums, listed under Other requirements.
review.heightMin: The ordinance sets a minimum of 11 stories or 129 ft.
review.frontSetbackMin: The 10 ft setback applies along Addison Road, the new street between Dallas Parkway and Addison Road, and Excel Parkway, not counting the motor court and loading and delivery areas. The Dallas Parkway setback is measured from back of curb.

notes: Sub-District A must follow the site plan, landscape plans and building elevations in Exhibit B.

notes.heading: Minimum dwelling unit size
items: Independent living: studio 800 sq ft, one bedroom 1,018 sq ft, two bedroom 1,150 sq ft.
Assisted living: studio 425 sq ft, one bedroom 570 sq ft, two bedroom 800 sq ft.

notes: At least 65% of the required parking must be in a parking garage, and no more than 20% may be in a surface lot.
A parking study must show that parking can be shared between uses with alternating times of use.
Park land dedication is at least 20,907 sq ft (0.48 acre), or a fee in lieu if the Town accepts one, priced at the market value of the land.

notes.heading: Streetscape
items: Addison Road: as set by the Master Transportation Plan.
Excel Parkway: Commercial Collector with Urban Pedestrian standards, with no on-street parking required.
New street along the south edge of Sub-District A: Commercial Collector with Urban Pedestrian standards, with on-street parking on both sides.
Dallas Parkway: an eight-foot sidewalk with parkway and landscape buffers with trees on both sides.

notes.heading: Sub-District B
items: Buildings must be at least 6 stories tall.
At least 550,000 sq ft of office space.
An amendment to the ordinance is required when Sub-District B develops, to set more standards.
